Create a single game tile sheet image for an isometric 2D game: a MINOAN TEMPLE building set,
in the style of 1980s anime background art (cel-painted, clean bold ink outlines, flat colour
areas with 2-3 tone cel shading, crisp highlights, saturated but warm palette, hand-painted
detail like an 80s anime film's backgrounds). Theme: a sacred Minoan sci-fi sanctuary - the
peak sanctuaries and palace shrines of Bronze Age Crete reimagined with ancient technology:
pale gypsum and alabaster ashlar walls, deep Minoan red and saffron-yellow plaster, frescoes
(priestesses with offerings, the snake goddess, griffins, lilies and saffron crocus, bull-leaping,
dolphins and octopus, spirals and running waves), tapering red columns with black cushion
capitals, gold horns of consecration, double axes (labrys) of bronze and gold, deep blue panels
with glowing cyan sacred light (energy channels, crystal lamps), incense smoke. Must sit with
the existing Minoan palace tile set (attach minoan_palace_tile_sheet.png as the reference for
scale, projection and layout) but have its own sacred, solemn character.

=== CANVAS (exact) ===
- Image size: exactly 2048 x 1920 pixels.
- Background: one flat solid colour, pure magenta #FF00FF, everywhere that is not a piece.
  No gradient, no texture, no vignette, no grid lines, no borders, no frames, no labels,
  no text, no title, no numbers, no drop shadows on the background.
- Grid: 8 columns x 6 rows of invisible cells, each cell exactly 256 x 320 pixels
  (cell x = col*256, cell y = row*320). Exactly ONE piece per cell, never crossing its cell.

=== PROJECTION (exact, no perspective) ===
- True 2:1 isometric (dimetric) projection: every receding edge rises exactly 1 pixel
  vertically per 2 pixels horizontally (26.565 deg). Vertical edges stay perfectly vertical.
  NO perspective, NO vanishing points, NO camera tilt - parallel lines stay parallel.
  Every piece uses this same projection and the same scale.
- Light comes from the upper-left for every piece. Faces turned to the left/front-left are
  lit; faces turned to the right are about 20% darker (flat cel shadow, not a gradient).

=== PIECE GEOMETRY (exact, in pixels, relative to each cell's top-left corner) ===
FLOOR / ROOF TILE = a flat diamond, 256 wide x 128 tall, corners at
  top (128,176), right (256,240), bottom (128,304), left (0,240).
  Flat top surface only, no side thickness. It must tile seamlessly with copies of itself
  edge to edge (patterns continue across edges).

WALL "LEFT" (wall running down-right, facing the viewer's left) = a parallelogram,
  corners (64,8) -> (192,72) -> (192,312) -> (64,248).
  i.e. 128 px wide, 240 px tall, top and bottom edges slope DOWN to the right at 2:1.

WALL "RIGHT" (wall running up-right, facing the viewer's right) = a parallelogram,
  corners (64,72) -> (192,8) -> (192,248) -> (64,312).
  i.e. top and bottom edges slope UP to the right at 2:1.
  Walls are seen face-on: draw only the front face (no top thickness, no side), filling
  the parallelogram completely. Left and right ends of each wall must tile seamlessly
  with the next wall segment (stone courses, friezes and trim continue across the joint).
  Every wall has the same base: a dark grey-blue stone dado along the bottom 12%, and a
  gold-and-red running-spiral cornice band along the top 6%.

DOORWAY WALL: same parallelogram, but the door opening is fully transparent (magenta)
  from 27% to 73% of the wall's width and from 36% of its height down to the bottom,
  framed by a gold door frame with horns of consecration above it.

STANDING OBJECTS (columns, props, decor): stand upright, centred horizontally in the cell,
  base touching y = 304 at x = 128, never wider than 220 px or taller than 300 px.
  Include only a small soft contact shadow directly under the object, nothing else.

=== CELL CONTENTS (row by row, columns 0..7) ===
Row 0 - FLOOR TILES (diamond): 0 pale gypsum flagstones, 1 gypsum flagstones variant,
  2 red-ochre sacred floor with white inlaid spiral, 3 blue-and-gold mosaic of an octopus,
  4 mosaic of lilies and saffron crocus, 5 glowing cyan energy-channel floor panel (lines
  of light in dark blue stone), 6 alabaster floor with a gold labrys inlay in the middle,
  7 worn, cracked temple paving.
Row 1 - WALLS facing LEFT (parallelogram "LEFT"): 0 plain saffron-yellow plaster,
  1 pale gypsum ashlar, 2 fresco procession of priestesses carrying offerings,
  3 fresco griffins among lilies, 4 fresco of the snake goddess with raised arms,
  5 shrine niche (a recessed alcove with a small gold labrys and a cyan glow),
  6 tall narrow window of glowing cyan crystal in a gold frame, 7 DOORWAY.
Row 2 - WALLS facing RIGHT (parallelogram "RIGHT"): the same eight designs as row 1,
  in the same order, drawn for this orientation and lighting (re-drawn, not mirrored,
  so the frescoes still read correctly).
Row 3 - ROOF TILES (diamond): 0 flat gypsum roof terrace, 1 red-plastered roof with a
  gold spiral border, 2 roof with a round skylight of cyan crystal, 3 roof garden of lilies
  and crocus, 4 roof with a row of small horns of consecration along its edge, 5 roof with
  a glowing sacred-fire vent, 6 gold-trimmed blue roof slab, 7 plain dark roof.
Row 4 - ARCHITECTURAL PIECES (standing objects): 0 red Minoan column (tapering downward,
  black cushion capital, gold bands) exactly 272 px tall, 1 alabaster column with gold
  capital, 272 px tall, 2 great gold horns of consecration, 3 tall bronze labrys on a
  stepped pedestal, 4 crystal obelisk glowing cyan, 5 roof corner cap with horns,
  6 red banner with a gold labrys on a pole, 7 sacred-fire tripod (gold bowl with flames).
Row 5 - DECOR (standing objects): 0 stone altar with gold horns, 1 snake-goddess statue on
  a pedestal, 2 bull's-head rhyton on a stand, 3 large painted pithos with octopus motif,
  4 offering table with fruit and cups, 5 incense burner with a thin wisp of smoke,
  6 potted lilies in a painted pot, 7 lustral basin with steps (a sunken stone bath with
  glowing water, drawn flat on the floor, filling a floor diamond).

=== RULES ===
- Keep every piece inside its cell; leave at least 4 px of magenta around each piece.
- Use the exact sizes above so all pieces share one scale: a wall is exactly one storey
  (240 px), a floor/roof tile is exactly 256 x 128.
- No floor tile, plinth or ground patch under standing objects - only their own base.
- Do not use magenta (#FF00FF) or near-magenta colours anywhere in the artwork.
- No people, no text, no labels, no captions, no watermark anywhere on the image.
